      "start": 1801.0,
      "end": 2003.0,

      "text": "The prince that was promised, man. He definitely underdelivered at different times but they replaced the head coach and made a deep run. I probably like this next one you have with the Jags."

      "start": 2003.0,

      "text": "The voters are going to have to try to find a way to vote for Travis Hunter. If he's healthy, playing both WR and CB, he can win Comeback Player of the Year at 35-to-1."
    },

      "speaker": "Seth Woolcock",

      "start": 2249.0,
      "end": 2397.0,
      "speaker": "Andrew Erickson",
      "text": "Offensive Player of the Year, Brock Bowers at 80-to-1. I just think that's too long for a player of his caliber. If he goes out there and breaks every tight end record playing with Cousins or Mendoza, he can win."
    },
    {
      "start": 2397.0,
      "end": 2541.0,
      "speaker": "Seth Woolcock",
      "text": "He can do some of that gritty underneath work and let Bowers loose. Offensive Player of the Year might be a stretch but at 80-to-1 I don't hate the thought process."
    },
    {
      "start": 2541.0,
      "end": 2716.0,
      "speaker": "Andrew Erickson",
      "text": "Looking at Malachi Lawrence for Defensive Rookie of the Year at 25-to-1. Just betting on this Dallas Cowboys defense being much better and generating a lot of sacks."
    },
    {
      "start": 2716.0,
      "end": 2808.0,
      "speaker": "Seth Woolcock",
      "text": "Malachi Lawrence definitely was a game-wrecker for UCF. He has played against some pretty good competition. I don't hate that number at 25-to-1."
    },
    {
      "start": 2808.0,
      "end": 2915.0,
      "speaker": "Andrew Erickson",
      "text": "Eli Stowers is the one I like the most at 92-to-1 for OROY. If Goedert gets banged up, they can throw Eli Stowers in there for an expanded role."

      "start": 2915.0,

      "text": "Elijah Sarratt to win OROY at 92-to-1 as well. He is one of the most pro-ready WRs, playing with Lamar Jackson. I think both these guys can get off to hot starts."
    }
